meta.name: alterlab-diffdock
meta.description: Predicts protein-ligand binding poses with DiffDock diffusion-based molecular docking from PDB structures and SMILES, producing pose confidence scores for virtual screening and structure-based drug design. Use when docking ligands into a protein, generating binding poses, or screening compounds against a target; not for binding affinity prediction. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与配体的结合姿态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做基于结构的药物设计或虚拟筛选
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do structure-based drug design or virtual screening

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 DiffDock 预测小分子配体与蛋白质的 3D 结合姿势，并给出置信度分数，用于虚拟筛选和药物设计。
howto.when: 当你要求“对接配体到蛋白质”、“预测结合姿势”或“虚拟筛选”时触发。需要本地安装 DiffDock 和 GPU。

say.text: 帮我用 DiffDock 对接这个配体到蛋白质 PDB 文件。
say.note: Claude 会运行单次对接并输出排名靠前的结合姿势。

say.text: 对这批化合物进行虚拟筛选，输出置信度分数。
say.note: Claude 会准备 CSV 并执行批量对接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use DiffDock to predict 3D binding poses of small molecule ligands to protein targets, outputting confidence scores for virtual screening and drug design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'dock a ligand to a protein', 'predict binding pose', or 'virtual screening'. Requires local DiffDock setup and GPU.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to the protein PDB file using DiffDock.
say_en.note: Claude runs single docking and outputs top-ranked poses.

say_en.text: Run virtual screening on this compound library with confidence scores.
say_en.note: Claude prepares CSV and executes batch docking.
